fieldValues.title: Subjects trace a matter across meetings, and fragment without a curator
fieldValues.summary: After two meetings 4 of 12 subjects span both, so a matter can be followed in date order; but the first meeting shaped the list, two matters split across subjects, and a mandatory link forced off-the-record topics under a subject.
evidence: Master 2026-11-27: water supply, spend and reporting, room lets, board engagement span both meetings
October's fire escape topic under a board-engagement subject; November created a fire escape subject
fieldValues.body: The persistent core has to be owned: merge, rename and retire subjects as a person's act, and let a topic have no subject.
